_readme: House ads for IradOne Online (its own promos). Most ads now come from Attelkom Jarnama (https://github.com/mjsbroadbent/jarnama, themes 'current' and 'state'), which site.js mixes in. Put images in ads/ and list them here. size is 'leaderboard' (728x90) or 'box' (300x250); set active to false to pause one. link can be a full URL, '#', or a path on this site.
